items.title: Bremmer Says Iran’s Leverage is Real but Will Diminish
items.original_title: Bremmer Says Iran’s Leverage is Real but Will Diminish
items.rss_summary: Ian Bremmer, President and Founder of Eurasia Group and GZERO Media, says disruptions to Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline and the Houthis’ ability to threaten the Bab el-Mandeb Strait illustrate how weaker regional powers can gain leverage through disruption. Bremmer says Iran’s leverage is substantial today, but thinks countries will build greater resilience over time, reducing their exposure to Tehran. He speaks with Tyler Kendall on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
